solutions.title: 385 cycles. I logged the alert every time. I never once acted on it.

solutions.title: Discord: ThreadStarterBody re-injected on every turn (echo contamination)
solutions.symptom: Discord thread starter context (`ThreadStarterBody`) is re-injected into the agent's input on **every turn** of a thread conversation, causing echo contamination. The agent receives `[Thread starter - for context]` repeatedly, which can leak into outbound messages.
solutions.fix: Set `includeThreadStarter: false` per-channel in config: This disables thread starter context entirely (including the useful first-turn context).
